{{Quote|Firepower is no replacement for surprise.|Infiltrator maxim|<ref name="RoE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>}}
'''Infiltrators''' were an elite military speciality, part of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Formed from those beings with a burning hatred for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Infiltrators were the most feared Alliance unit, and the terror of Imperial soldiers throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Masters of stealth, silent weapons, and [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand combat]], Infiltrators penetrated enemy lines and installations to carry out raids, sabotage, and disruption missions.

==Organization==
The Infiltrators were a military speciality of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]].<ref name="RASB" /> The 5th Regiment of a SpecForce division was comprised entirely of Infiltrators.<ref name="RoE" /> Infiltrators were deployed as SpecForce's eyes and ears; masters of stealth, they were trained to penetrate enemy lines and facilities to sow fear and confusion,<ref name="RASB" /> conduct sabotage and critical missions,<ref name="RoE" /> and distract officers to disrupt command and control operations.<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The most feared of all of SpecForce's [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], Infiltrators were highly skilled in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|hand-to-hand]] and [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee]] combat, and employed [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] and silent weapons to achieve their objectives.<ref name="RoE" /> They were able to bypass mechanical and organic security systems,<ref name="RASB" /> and the perfect Infiltrator mission was one that was not detected for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after the Infiltrators had exfiltrated.<ref name="RoE" />

==History==
{{Quote|Trooper, I don't want to know your name until we've both come back from a mission.|Unidentified Infiltrator|<ref name="RoE" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Infiltrators were the busiest branch of SpecForce, constantly being assigned to missions, sometimes at the behest of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], and sometimes loaned to Intelligence to work under their direction.<ref name="RoE" />

An Infiltrator team was deployed during [[Operation Cobolt]], a mission to capture an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scandoc decoding computer]] from an [[Imperial orbital base|orbital base]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]]. Twenty Infiltrators were inserted onto the station aboard an Imperial supply craft, where they proceeded to disable the base [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], weapons, and communications. A further assault of [[Marines (SpecForce)|Marines]] assault the station to recover the computer and further sabotage the base, and the assault plan called for the Infiltrators to hold their position until relieved, then extract out on the marine assault shuttles. All Infiltrators were listed as missing, presumed dead, during the operation, which was a success.<ref name="Report">{{WEGCite|story=General Madine's Report on Operation Cobolt|book=The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>

[[Taskforce Shen]] was an Infiltrator [[Company/Legends|company]] based around two Infiltrator [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]], along with a [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] platoon and two squads of [[Technicians]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Mart Stevez]] commanded the company, and their mission profiles included silent raids, ambushes, and striking critical targets. Taskforce Shen was often loaned to Alliance Intelligence to perform extraction missions, usually of data or personnel.<ref name="RoE" />

==Personnel==
{{Quote|Sentries One through Ten eliminated. Moving to second position.|Infiltrator|<ref name="RoE" />}}
[[File:Infiltrator_Spec.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An Infiltrator wielding a knife]]
Infiltrators were drawn from recruits that had joined the Alliance after the Empire had torn their lives apart. Many had lost everything that they held dear; refusing to give in to the pain, they vowed to destroy the Empire in return. Commitment and combat performance led to their induction into SpecForce, while their personality and hatred for the Empire got them assigned to the Infiltrators. Their skills were honed to peak perfection, and they were masters of stealth operations. Following [[drop camp]], they received advanced training in hand-to-hand combat, melee combat, and the use of [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] and archaic mechanical weapons. One [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of their training involved the recruits being sealed in a black hangar and forced to operate entirely without their vision, relying on their other senses.<ref name="RoE" />

Infiltrators were the terror of Imperial forces; they were quiet, highly focused, and disciplined. They had little interest in anything that did not hasten the destruction of the Empire, and their only desire was to repeatedly hurt the Empire until it was destroyed. Their methodology earned them the nicknames of "wraiths," "ghosts," and "shadows" among their fellow Specs.<ref name="RoE" />

Major Mart Stevez commanded Taskforce Shen during the Galactic Civil War. A former member of the [[Atrisian Assault Corps|Atrisian Royal Corps]], his family&mdash;[[Mart Stevez's wife|wife]], [[Mart Stevez's son|son]], and [[Mart Stevez's daughter|daughter]]&mdash;was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by the Imperial [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] after his [[Mart Stevez's father|father]] was considered to be "politically unreliable." Joining the Alliance after neutralizing the assassins sent after him, Stevez assisted in the formation of the first Infiltrator teams.<ref name="RoE" />

[[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] [[Vu Nin]] was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Sector Force/Legends|SecForce]] soldier who requested a SpecForce transfer following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Although she originally wanted to join the [[Alderaanian Death Legion]], she was assigned to Taskforce Shen instead as they needed Infiltrators following a mission that had ended badly.<ref name="RoE" />

[[Vin Northal/Legends|Vin Northal]], a former member of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]], served as a training instructor for the Infiltrators in his spare time.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>

==Skills==
{{Quote|Infiltrator. You can't see 'em, hear 'em or touch 'em. They were heading out to the Imperial strongpoint to soften things up for us, take out a few stormtroopers and scare the ''flarg'' out of the officers.|Sergeant Hork|<ref name="Whiskers">{{WEGCite|story=Whiskers|book=Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook}}</ref>}}
[[File:Infiltrators-RoE.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Infiltrators sneaking past Imperial forces]]
Infiltrators were experts in the fields of stealth operations, hand-to-hand combat, and silenced weapons.<ref name="RoE" /> They were trained to use [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]<ref name="RASB2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> and [[Slugthrower/Legends|firearms]] such as [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]].<ref name="RoE" /> They were also proficient in the use of [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]], such as [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknifes]].<ref name="RASB2" /> [[Repulsorlift/Legends|Repulsorlift]] operation and survival training was drilled into Infiltrators, as well as the skills to defeat security systems, to effectively use demolitions equipment,<ref name="RASB" /> and to conduct sabotage.<ref name="RoE" />

==Equipment==
Infiltrators were generally deployed in the field with minimal equipment.<ref name="RoE" /> Their main weapons of choice were the [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]<ref name="RASB2" /> or [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]],<ref name="RECG" /> vibroknife, and [[Garrote/Legends|garrote]],<ref name="RASB2" /> and they also favored [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[IR-5 "Intimidator"|Intimidator IR-5s]]. Silent weapons were the order of the day for Infiltrators, such as silenced slugthrower pistols&mdash;such as the [[Adjudicator (slugthrower)|Adjudicator]]&mdash; and silenced subsonic [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]]. Melee weapons included [[Slicewire/Legends|slicewire]], [[snap baton]]s, and [[multi-weapon]]s. Mechanical weapons were also prevalent in the Infiltrator arsenal, including [[bolt-thrower]]s, [[magna caster]]s, and [[Vac Attack Mk-127/Legends|vac blades]].<ref name="RoE" /> [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|Fragmentation grenades]], [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]], and [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] rigged with a timer were also carried by Infiltrators.<ref name="RECG" />

Infiltrators made use of climbing gear for insertions, and had special equipment that allowed them to suspend from ceilings. A surprise attack from above was one of the Infiltrator's favorite tactics. Select units were equipped with [[shadowsuit]]s, and sensor-baffling [[No-Show]]s were deployed when needed. Infiltrators preferred to use [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]], such as the [[Whisper (jet pack)|Whisper jet pack]], for fast movement, and also employed the [[ShadoWing-4]] [[para-wing glider]] when necessary. Infiltrators rarely used [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]],<ref name="RoE" /> but when they did, theirs were encrypted.<ref name="RECG" />
